shortDescription: Goldman Sachs NYSE:GS has named Farshid Asl and Matt Weir as co-heads of its Investment Strategy Group, succeeding Sharmin Mossavar-Rahmani, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters on Thursday.Here are some details:

children: has named Farshid Asl and Matt Weir as co-heads of its Investment Strategy Group, succeeding Sharmin Mossavar-Rahmani, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters on Thursday.
Mossavar-Rahmani, who has led the Investment Strategy Group and served as chief investment officer of Wealth Management, will retire later this year after three decades at the bank, the memo said.
She joined Goldman as a partner in 1993 after working at Fidelity Management, where she was chief investment officer for fixed-income accounts.
In July, Goldman reported a 20% rise in second-quarter asset and wealth management revenue, extending a strong run for the business.
Both Asl and Weir have had a two-decade long career at Goldman Sachs. Weir most recently was managing director of Investment Strategy Group, Asset & Wealth Management.
Mossavar-Rahmani will work with the Investment Strategy Group and wealth management teams over the coming months to ensure a smooth transition, the memo said.
